symptom: Mendix 11.14.0, MPR v2: `@applyentityaccess(false)` on `create or modify microflow MyModule.DS_Tile_Count` whose body is `$List = call microflow MyModule.SUB_Scoped_List();` (an `@applyentityaccess(true)` microflow, in the project or created earlier in the script) passed `check -p --references` with "no flow change exec would refuse … no used flow left without access" and "Check passed!"; mxbuild then reported "CE0114 A microflow that does not apply entity access can only call microflows that also do not apply entity access."
cause: No check modelled the rule: it is a consistency rule between two documents' ApplyEntityAccess, not a reference, so reference validation could not see it
file: `mdl/executor/validate_entity_access_calls.go` (CheckEntityAccessCalls, MDL-SEC22), wired into the project tier of `cmd/mxcli/cmd_check.go`
insight: Measure the direction and the call shapes before modelling — the message names only microflows, but a DECISION on a rule that applies entity access is the same CE0114 with "rules" (stored as Microflows$RuleCall.Microflow, the same key as Microflows$MicroflowCall). Measured on mxbuild 11.13.0 and 11.14.0, fresh projects: off->on call and off->rule-on decision -> CE0114; on->off, on->on, off->off, nanoflow->on, EXCLUDED off->on -> nothing; Off and Prototype security alike, so unlike CE0106 it is always an error. A decision is a rule call only if the name is a rule when exec builds the caller (IsRule at build time), so the simulation resolves rule-ness in statement order but microflow callees at the end of the script. An absent @applyentityaccess on create or modify carries the stored value (carriedApplyEntityAccess) — the simulation must use the same function or it false-flags every rewrite of a stored caller that applies entity access. Check-only prediction (exec does not refuse), so not language-version gated, the MDL-SEC21 precedent. Two-variant mxbuild 11.14.0 run on a fresh project with the callee stored: issue script -> check -p MDL-SEC22 exit 1, exec anyway -> docker check 1x CE0114; caller with @applyentityaccess(true) -> check passes, docker check 0 errors. Revert-proof: gate stubbed -> 6 positive tests fail with 'got 0'; callee-setting test removed -> the off->off control fails
